name: The Pitt Expedition Drop Tables & Stamps
categories: The Pitt • Union Power Armor • Auto Axe Plans • Giuseppe Stamps
description: Union Dues & From Ashes to Fire reward structures. Guarantees 15–20 Stamps per perfect run, 1-Star to 4-Star legendary items, and rare Auto Axe / Union Power Armor mod plans from Giuseppe at Whitespring Refuge.
notes: Full reward matrix for Union Dues and From Ashes to Fire including bonus objectives and Fanatic Troopers boss loot.

name: Atlantic City Expedition Drop Tables & Stamps
categories: Atlantic City • Tax Evasion • Sensational Game • Human Condition
description: Tax Evasion, The Most Sensational Game & Human Condition reward tables. Yields 15–20 Stamps, Civil Engineer Armor plans, and Municipal Center casino rewards.
notes: Full reward matrix for Atlantic City Boardwalk & Municipal Center missions including Overgrown and Muni enemy drops.

name: Playable Ghoul Race & S.P.E.C.I.A.L. Tuning
description: Transforms player into a Ghoul at Level 50+. Replaces human Rad damage with instant HP healing, adds Feral Gauge mechanics, and introduces specialized Ghoul perk synergies under standard 15-cap S.P.E.C.I.A.L. limits.
notes: Playable Ghouls shipped in Patch 58 'Glow of the Ghoul' (18 Mar 2025). Ghoul perks are in the Perk Deck.

name: Infestation 4-Star Legendary Mods
categories: Armor • Power Armor • Weapon: Ranged • Weapon: Melee
description: 4th star legendary mods that drop from Infestation bosses. Crafting a 4-star mod costs 120 Legendary Modules plus a material; applying it to a normal item costs a fixed 100 Scrip.
notes: Shipped in Patch 68 'Infestations' (2 Jun 2026): Aegis, Battle-Loader's, Hauler's, Polished, Propelling, Radioactive-Powered, Raging, Satiated, Stabilizer's, Tarnished, Vector. Infestation bosses drop a 4-star item 100% of the time.

name: Unique Weapon & Armor Modding
description: Named unique weapons and armor can have their legendary mods changed and a 4th legendary mod added. Fixed 50/100 scrip for normal items; 10x for uniques.
notes: Shipped in Patch 70 'The Slasher' (15 Sep 2026). Mod changes on uniques cost 10x the normal fixed scrip (500 for 1-3 star, 1,000 for 4 star). Crafting onto a unique: 30 modules + 40 Vault Steel (3 star) or 65 modules + 80 Vault Steel (4 star).

name: Milepost Zero Caravan Upgrades
description: Brahmin speed, health, and defense upgrades for Skylanes Caravan runs. Unlocks Ineke, Theodore, Axel, and Josie vendor stalls in Milepost Zero headquarters.
notes: Unlocks V63 Laser Carbine plans from Theodore and custom ammo crafting options.
